title: Sensitive Outputs
scenario: Outputs can carry secrets. Mark a token output sensitive so Terraform redacts it in plan and apply output while still making the value available to the caller.

focus.title: Complete the sensitive output
focus.todo: Set the value from the variable and mark the output sensitive.

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked TODO in `outputs.tf`. Set the value from the variable and mark the output sensitive. Use the visible constraints as your checklist before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `outputs.tf` and work inside the single TODO region. Change one requirement at a time: add the named block, argument or reference, then run the tests. When a check fails, match its wording to the constraints and fix only the block it names.
